That evening he climbed the stairs a little lighter, knowing the beam he trimmed each night had reached someone far beyond the water.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市还在沉睡。街灯把空荡的马路照成一条淡黄的河，偶尔一辆出租车驶过，留下渐远的轮胎声。便利店的灯亮着，店员靠在柜台边打盹。清洁工推着小车，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。高楼的窗大多黑着，只有零星几扇透出微光，不知是早起的人，还是未眠的人。空气里有潮湿的凉意，天边尚未发白。这座城市暂时卸下喧嚣，安静地等待着又一个黎明的到来。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller copy of the same problem.\n• Imagine standing in a line and asking the person ahead how many people are in front, each person asks the next until someone says zero.\n• The answers get passed back one by one until you know the total."}
